# prerequisites are done, count the planner days, then complete.
wif_sib_auto_CSR = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = wif_csr_banners_spread } has_completed_focus = wif_csr_tomsk_declaration }
		add_to_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_csr_banners_spread = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_csr_banners_spread > 139 } }
			set_country_flag = wif_sib_auto_wif_csr_banners_spread
			complete_national_focus = wif_csr_banners_spread
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = wif_csr_rail_sabotage } has_completed_focus = wif_csr_banners_spread }
		add_to_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_csr_rail_sabotage = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_csr_rail_sabotage > 209 } }
			set_country_flag = wif_sib_auto_wif_csr_rail_sabotage
			complete_national_focus = wif_csr_rail_sabotage
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = wif_csr_sermons } has_completed_focus = wif_csr_tomsk_declaration }
		add_to_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_csr_sermons = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_csr_sermons > 139 } }
			set_country_flag = wif_sib_auto_wif_csr_sermons
			complete_national_focus = wif_csr_sermons
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = wif_csr_blessing } has_completed_focus = wif_csr_sermons }
		add_to_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_csr_blessing = 7 }

		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = wif_csr_grain_census } has_completed_focus = wif_csr_tomsk_declaration }

	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = wif_fes_doctors } has_completed_focus = wif_fes_sleeps_badly }
		add_to_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_fes_doctors = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_fes_doctors > 139 } }
			set_country_flag = wif_sib_auto_wif_fes_doctors
			complete_national_focus = wif_fes_doctors
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = wif_fes_shadows } has_completed_focus = wif_fes_doctors }
		add_to_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_fes_shadows = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_fes_shadows > 209 } }
			set_country_flag = wif_sib_auto_wif_fes_shadows
			complete_national_focus = wif_fes_shadows
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = wif_fes_hungry_winter } has_completed_focus = wif_fes_irkutsk }
		add_to_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_fes_hungry_winter = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_fes_hungry_winter > 69 } }
			set_country_flag = wif_sib_auto_wif_fes_hungry_winter
			complete_national_focus = wif_fes_hungry_winter
		}
	}
}

# WSM scope, weekly. The focuses that do themselves: once the
# prerequisites are done, count the planner days, then complete.
wif_sib_auto_WSM = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = wif_wsm_whispers } has_completed_focus = wif_wsm_rebuild_organs }
		add_to_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_wsm_whispers = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_wsm_whispers > 139 } }
			set_country_flag = wif_sib_auto_wif_wsm_whispers
			complete_national_focus = wif_wsm_whispers
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = wif_wsm_officers_resent } has_completed_focus = wif_wsm_whispers }
		add_to_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_wsm_officers_resent = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_wsm_officers_resent > 209 } }
			set_country_flag = wif_sib_auto_wif_wsm_officers_resent
			complete_national_focus = wif_wsm_officers_resent
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = wif_wsm_cracks } has_completed_focus = wif_wsm_officers_resent }
		add_to_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_wsm_cracks = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { wif_sib_t_wif_wsm_cracks > 279 } }
			set_country_flag = wif_sib_auto_wif_wsm_cracks
			complete_national_focus = wif_wsm_cracks
		}
	}
}
